article.story: DURHAM, N.H. -- — Kijan Robinson had 17 points in New Hampshire's 80-72 win against Albany on Saturday. Robinson shot 4 of 8 from the field, including 3 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 6 from the line for the Wildcats (7-12, 3-3 America East Conference). Jack Graham added 15 points while shooting 5 for 13, including 5 for 10 from beyond the arc. Comeh Emuobor shot 2 of 5 from the field and 9 for 10 from the line to finish with 13 points. Miles Rose finished with 20 points for the Great Danes (7-14, 3-3). Amir Lindsey added 16 points and six rebounds for Albany. Isaac Abidde also had 12 points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
